main_text.head: נחם על הרעה[?] Pœnitens super malo.
main_text.p: De malo pœnæ intelligatur. Verè miseret Deum calamitoforum: ac cum illi resipiscũt, vel mitigat afflictiones, vel tollit. Immò, ne quidem cæterorum interi-tu delectatur, sicut est videre in historia diluvij. Etsi autem non est Deus volens iniquitatem,Psal.5. & irascitur omni die impio: tamen propter paucos bonos parcit multis malis,Gen.18.

Dicitur etiam pœnitere super malo, cū eos in gratiam recipit, quibus nisi resipiscerent, atrocissimas pœnas denunciaverat: ut Ninivitarum exemplum ostendit. Pepercit enim illis Dominus,cum ad meliorem frugem essent conversi.

Ex ijs quę iam dicta sunt, discimus, Nō esse cur nostri iudicij maiorem, quàm divinæ bonitatis rationem habeamus: ac non indulgentiæ nimiæ Deum nobis insimulandum, sed eius erga nos bonitate & φιλανθρωπίαν[?] religiosè celebradam,nobisq; & alijs congratulatione summa excipiendam.
main_text.head: VERSVS III.
main_text.l: Nunc ergo, ô Iehovah, tolle quæso anima[?] meam Lectio 62.[?]20. Iunij, 1581.

page.notes: The Hebrew catchline is partly unclear and its pointing is uncertain. The Greek word φιλανθρωπίαν is uncertain in accent and final letter. "Lectio 62." is uncertain in its numeral. The verse word "anima" has an uncertain final mark. The verse line runs over two printed lines and is given as one line. The catchline is treated as a level-2 heading, which is a judgement from its position. Printed spacing in "tol lit" and "me liorem" is normalised to "tollit" and "meliorem".
